_note: What a home-made amendment can be built from, for 2027/28 only (£m; a saving or extra income is negative). Every figure is one the council printed. Council tax and fees lines use the council's own sensitivity figures or the difference between its Table 4 and Table 5. Savings options are the items in Appendix 2 to the September 2026 report that are not yet approved. Spending options are last year's proposals at the cost their proposers gave for 2026/27, labelled as such. recurring: true if it carries on into later years. risk names a reason the Section 151 Officer would flag.

funds._note: One-off spending may come from the Revenue Support Reserve; continuing spending may not (council policy). No cap is set beyond that, because the reserve's 2027/28 balance is not published.

reserve.label: The Revenue Support Reserve (one-off spending only)
reserve.at: MTFS 2027-31, reserves table and para. 63, p. 16

fees1.label: Raise fees and charges by 1%, not 2%
